training_weights: Each market has total weight one, spread equally over its eligible opportunities; rescale mean weight to one within split.

P3.features: same eight by eleven history tensor flattened as P4

P4.features: same eight by eleven history tensor as P3

primary: equal-market mean log loss and Brier; paired market differences P3 vs P4, both versus P0; five-day date-block sensitivity only if dates support it
final_rule: Fit/calibrate/select with train/dev only; freeze code, fitted models, hashes and one primary P3-vs-P4 comparison before one final chronological read. Report all P0-P4 and all seeds regardless of sign.
limits: Four dates total, partial final date, sampled markets; final is a narrow exploratory pilot. No WSE independent-confirmation claim.
